title: China Slows Sales at the Owner of Louis Vuitton

source.author: LVMH (company press release)
source.title: Continued growth in the third quarter of 2026

figures.text: €57.1 billion revenue in first nine months of 2026
figures.quote: recorded revenue of €57.1 billion in the first nine months of 2026

figures.text: Q3 organic growth 1% (table: Total LVMH, Q3 2026 vs Q3 2025 organic +1%); FashionUnited agrees
figures.quote: In the third quarter of 2026, organic revenue growth stood at 1 percent YoY.

figures.text: China weaker; US, Europe, Japan good growth
figures.quote: a less buoyant environment in China ... while the United States, Europe and Japan saw good growth

figures.text: organic = constant scope and currency (table footnote)
Fashion & Leather Goods: 26.4 billion euros (26,391 million) in 9M, -2% organic; largest division (FashionUnited)
figures.quote: saw organic revenue decrease 2 percent YoY over the first nine months to 26.39 billion euros
Third-quarter organic revenue for the segment fell 5 percent YoY

figures.text: fashion helped by US market, hurt in Q3 by China
figures.quote: continued to benefit from the buoyant US market but was affected in the third quarter by the slowdown in demand in China

figures.text: Louis Vuitton: Monogram is 130 years old (130th anniversary); iconic bags
figures.quote: honoured its iconic bags ... for the 130th anniversary of the Monogram

figures.text: Dior store on Via Monte Napoleone, Milan, September
figures.quote: a new House of Dior flagship store was opened in September, on Via Monte Napoleone in Milan

figures.text: Marc Jacobs sold to WHP Global on September 1
figures.quote: On September 1, Marc Jacobs was sold to WHP Global.
recorded organic revenue growth of 8% in the first nine months of 2026, driven by the very good performance in jewelry
posted an 8 percent organic rise in the third quarter
new market entries in Belgium and Croatia
remained stable on an organic basis in the first nine months of 2026

figures.text: goal: reinforce global leadership in luxury in 2026
figures.quote: to reinforce its global leadership position in luxury goods once again in 2026
